text:
ashley (People Ops): Heads up 3: Leo asked about switching from salaried FT to a 3/4 FTE reduced schedule starting 9/1 for school semester. He's worried about hitting the HSA family limit this year. Do we auto-prorate contributions or is it per-pay? Also question on midyear re-enrollment windows. cc @kevin.payroll @selena-benefits

kevin.payroll: Payroll deducts HSA as payroll elections each pay. We don't auto-prorate the annual election; instead, per-pay deductions change as gross changes. If Leo wants the same annual $ toward HSA he should increase the per-pay % for the reduced-pay period. No automatic true-up.

selena-benefits: Plan admin (Fidelity) allows midyear changes in case of qualifying life event (e.g., change of status), but FTE change alone usually isn't a QLE. However, employees may adjust their payroll elections any time outside of open enrollment for pretax deferrals? Actually we allow election changes for HSA & FSA only during open enrollement or QLEs. For 401k deferrals they can change anytime via portal. So HSA midyear changes are restricted unless it's a QLE.

ashley (People Ops): Wait 3 that matters. Leo's worried because spouse claims on spouse's plan changed? Manager said spouse's coverage changed too; Leo might have a QLE. Leo, is this the case?

leo-employee: Yes spouse moved to different employer plan on 8/15 which made me lose family coverage option. So I think that is a QLE. How do I submit paperwork to change HSA election?

selena-benefits: If spouse change is a QLE, then yes, you can change HSA election midyear. Submit a QLE form + proof (insurance change letter) to benefits@redwood.example within 30 days. Once approved we'll process change and update payroll. If the change is approved, payroll will apply the new per-pay deduction prospectively; we don't retroactively true-up.

kevin.payroll: FYI on timing: need the QLE approved before the first pay after the effective change to avoid gaps. Also note payroll cutoff is Tuesday 4pm PT for our biweekly schedule. If Leo's spouse coverage ended 8/15 and Leo wants family -> individual change effective 8/16, get docs in before the cutoff for the pay period containing 8/16.

ashley (People Ops): Action items: 1) Leo to submit QLE docs to benefits@redwood.example. 2) Selena to confirm approval and update payroll. 3) Kevin to ensure payroll cutoff timing is communicated.

hr-bot: Link: benefits portal QLE submission: https://benefits.redwood.example/qle. Reminder: HSA annual limits: 2026 individual $3850, family $7750.

leo-employee: Thanks all, I'll send docs today. Appreciate the cutoff reminder.

ashley (People Ops): Also note: if Leo's HSA premium changes midyear and he's already hit family max, switching to individual won't trigger a refund; he'd simply have already maxed via earlier family deductions. We'll confirm specifics after approval.

kevin.payroll: Quick note: if Leo also wants to adjust 401k deferrals to keep take-home steady, he can do that anytime in portal.
